---
title: "Add Minimal Attributes to the NGEN Hydrofabric"
date: "2026-04-30"
params:
  nextgen_geopackage: "..."
  soil_grid: "..."
  vegetation_grid: "..."
  impervious_grid: "..."
  groundwater_basins_table: "..."
  channel_geometry_table: "..."
  vpu_id: "..."
  output_nextgen_geopackage: "..."
---


```{r}
library(sf)
library(hfngen)
library(arrow)
```


## Compute Minimal Divide Attributes

```{r}

# Compute minimal divide attributes
# Requires the following input datasetys:
# ISLTYP - Soil Type Grid - https://proxy.lynker-spatial.com/gridded/nwm/CONUS/ 
# IVGTYP - Vegetation Type Grid - https://proxy.lynker-spatial.com/gridded/nwm/CONUS/ 
# IMP - Impervious Surfaces Grid - https://proxy.lynker-spatial.com/gridded/nwm/CONUS/derived/
# GW - Ground Water Basin Table - https://proxy.lynker-spatial.com/tabular/ 

# load the groundwater basins using arrow. This is because the 
# minimal_div_atts fucntion takes a table object
gw_basins <- arrow::open_dataset(params$groundwater_basins_table)

# compute the divide attributes
div_atts <- minimal_div_atts(params$nextgen_geopackage,
                             ISLTYP = params$soil_grid,
                             IVGTYP = params$vegetation_grid,
                             IMP    = params$impervious_grid,
                             GW     = gw_basins)


```


## Compute Minimal Flowpath Attributes

```{r}

# Read the network layer within the nextgen geopackage into a tibble
net = sf::read_sf(params$nextgen_geopackage, "network")


# Load the channel geometry table into memory 
hydraulic_atts <- arrow::open_dataset(params$channel_geometry_table)

# Compute the minimal channel attributes
atts = c('owp_y_bf', 'owp_tw_bf','bf_area', 'owp_roughness_bathy','slope')
flow_atts <- calculate_flow_atts(net,
                    hydraulic_atts,
                    hf_id = "flowline_id",
                    attribute_cols = atts,
                    weight_col = 'lengthkm')
```


## Enrich Flowpath Attributes

```{r}

# --- Y (bankfull depth) ---
# calculate_flow_atts() computes owp_y_bf internally but drops it from its
# output. Re-derive it here as a length-weighted mean from the hydraulics table.
#
# --- alt (channel bed elevation) ---
# alt is sourced from the hydraulics table only if present; otherwise set to NA.
hydraulics_cols <- names(hydraulic_atts)
alt_cols <- intersect("alt", hydraulics_cols)

y_alt <- hydraulic_atts |>
  dplyr::select(reference_id = feature_id, owp_y_bf, dplyr::any_of("alt"), lengthkm) |>
  dplyr::filter(reference_id %in% unique(net$reference_id)) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(net, reference_id, flowline_id) |> dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "reference_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(flowline_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Y   = weighted.mean(owp_y_bf, w = lengthkm, na.rm = TRUE),
    alt = if ("alt" %in% alt_cols) weighted.mean(alt, w = lengthkm, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Topology: to, id, toid, vpuid ---
# flowline_id  -> link  (already the key column in flow_atts)
# flowline_toid -> to   (downstream NHD flowline)
# flowpath_id  -> id    (NextGen catchment ID, e.g. wb-XXXXX)
# flowpath_toid -> toid (downstream NextGen catchment)
topology <- net |>
  dplyr::select(flowline_id, to = flowline_toid, id = flowpath_id, toid = flowpath_toid) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    id   = gsub("^fp-", "wb-", id),
    toid = gsub("^fp-", "wb-", toid),
    vpuid = params$vpu_id
  )

# --- gage_nex_id ---
# For each flowline that has a gage hydrolocation, look up the nexus ID whose
# poi_id matches that gage's POI.
nexus_pois <- net |>
  dplyr::select(flowpath_id, poi_id) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(poi_id)) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::mutate(nexus_id = gsub("^fp-", "nex-", flowpath_id)) |>
  dplyr::select(nexus_id, poi_id)

gage_nex <- net |>
  dplyr::filter(hl_class == "gage") |>
  dplyr::select(flowline_id, poi_id) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::left_join(nexus_pois, by = "poi_id") |>
  dplyr::select(flowline_id, gage_nex_id = nexus_id)

# --- WaterbodyID and waterbody_nex_id ---
# hl_reference holds the waterbody identifier when hl_class is WBIn or WBOut.
wb_nex <- net |>
  dplyr::filter(hl_class %in% c("WBIn", "WBOut")) |>
  dplyr::select(flowline_id, poi_id, WaterbodyID = hl_reference) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::left_join(nexus_pois, by = "poi_id") |>
  dplyr::select(flowline_id, WaterbodyID, waterbody_nex_id = nexus_id)

# --- Assemble final flowpath attributes table ---
flow_atts <- flow_atts |>
  dplyr::rename(
    link     = flowline_id,
    Length_m = lengthm,
    gage     = hl_reference
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(y_alt,    by = c("link" = "flowline_id")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(topology, by = c("link" = "flowline_id")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gage_nex, by = c("link" = "flowline_id")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(wb_nex,   by = c("link" = "flowline_id")) |>
  dplyr::select(
    n, nCC, BtmWdth, TopWdth, TopWdthCC, ChSlp, So, MusX, MusK,
    link, to, Length_m, Y, alt, gage, gage_nex_id,
    WaterbodyID, waterbody_nex_id, id, toid, vpuid
  )
```

## Save the Computed Attributes to the NGEN Geopackage

```{r}

# Copy the input geopackage to a new file, then add the attributes
file.copy(params$nextgen_geopackage, params$output_nextgen_geopackage)

# Add divide attributes to the ngen geopackage
div_atts$vpuid <- params$vpu_id
# TODO: Placeholder for dist_4.twi — a 4-bin equal-frequency TWI quantile distribution
# stored as a JSON array (e.g. [{"v":4.0,"frequency":0.25}, ...]). Implementation will
# be completed when TWI data is made available on HydroShare.
div_atts$dist_4.twi <- "[{}]"
st_write(div_atts,
         params$output_nextgen_geopackage,
         layer = "divide-attributes",
         append = TRUE)


# Add the flowpath attributes to the ngen geopackage
st_write(flow_atts,
         params$output_nextgen_geopackage,
         layer = "flowpath-attributes",
         append = TRUE)
```
